title: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
englishTitle: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
title_english: Though I Am an Inept Villainess

synonyms: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
alternative_titles.en: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
alternative_titles.ja: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～

synopsis:
In the kingdom of Ei, the Maiden Court is located within the palace's inner court, whose purpose is to nurture the next empress and four imperial consorts from five prominent clans. The crown prince's favorite is the virtuous Reirin Kou, excelling in every task she is given despite her sickly constitution. In contrast, Keigetsu Shu is considered a hindrance due to her ill-mannered conduct. While Reirin is a graceful butterfly beloved by all, Keigetsu is a sewer rat no one dares to look at.

During the Double Sevens Festival, a jealous Keigetsu attempts to murder Reirin by pushing her off a balcony. Fortunately, Reirin is saved from an untimely death, whereas Keigetsu is imprisoned and awaits her punishment. Unbeknownst to all, Keigetsu has used forbidden magic to swap bodies with Reirin, wishing to have Reirin's perfect life. 

However, not all goes according to Keigetsu's plan, as Reirin's weak body obstructs her evil schemes. At the same time, Reirin enjoys Keigetsu's physically fit build. Being unbound by rules, Reirin takes on the mission to live by playing the role of a villainess, no matter how inept she might be.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
background: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den was released on Blu-ray in two volumes from November 18, 2026, to December 16, 2026.

synopsis_es:
En el reino de Ei, la Corte de las Doncellas se encuentra dentro del patio interior del palacio, cuyo propósito es criar a la próxima emperatriz y a cuatro consortes imperiales de cinco clanes prominentes. La favorita del príncipe heredero es la virtuosa Reirin Kou, sobresaliendo en cada tarea que se le asigna a pesar de su enfermiza constitución. Por el contrario, Keigetsu Shu es considerada un obstáculo debido a su conducta maleducada. Mientras que Reirin es una elegante mariposa amada por todos, Keigetsu es una rata de alcantarilla a la que nadie se atreve a mirar.

Durante el Festival Double Sevens, Keigetsu, celoso, intenta asesinar a Reirin empujándola desde un balcón. Afortunadamente, Reirin se salva de una muerte prematura, mientras que Keigetsu está encarcelada y espera su castigo. Sin que todos lo sepan, Keigetsu ha usado magia prohibida para intercambiar cuerpos con Reirin, deseando tener la vida perfecta de Reirin. 

Sin embargo, no todo va según el plan de Keigetsu, ya que el débil cuerpo de Reirin obstruye sus malvados planes. Al mismo tiempo, Reirin disfruta de la buena forma física de Keigetsu. Al no estar sujeta a reglas, Reirin asume la misión de vivir interpretando el papel de una villana, sin importar cuán inepta pueda ser.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
